description: Merge a review-mode branch into contentrain. Local git operation — no external platform needed. Merges the feature branch into the contentrain branch, advances the base branch via update-ref, selectively syncs .contentrain/ files to the working tree, and prunes the merged branch. Target by exact "branch" name, or resolve by "model" (+ optional "locale"/"latest").

branch.description: Exact branch name to merge (e.g. cr/content/blog-post/...). Omit to resolve by model.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the merge

latest.description: When multiple branches match the model, merge the most recently committed one.

locale.description: Narrow model resolution to a locale.

model.description: Resolve the branch by model id (e.g. "blog-post").

name: contentrain_merge
